_note: The browser lane. Chrome on this machine, its own profile (nothing of Tariq's is logged in unless added on purpose), remote debugging on a port of its own. allowedHosts is the whole list of sites the worker may open; a subdomain of a listed host is allowed. Add a host when Tariq names a portal. httpbin.org and example.com are for tests only. dashboardUrl is the TFA Agents dashboard as this machine reaches it; `node tools/tfa.mjs browser-login` puts Tariq's session into the profile so the worker can screenshot it (127.0.0.1 is on the list for that alone).
